description: This file defines a React component named DeploymentStatusBarChart that renders a themed, accessible bar chart visualizing deployment counts by status. It includes internal methods for rendering tooltips, labels, and handling user interactions, and imports several external modules for charting, theming, and utility functions.

methods.name: CustomTooltip
methods.description: A React component for rendering custom tooltip content showing deployment status and count.

methods.name: ValueLabel
methods.description: A React component for rendering labels above each bar in the chart.

methods.name: auditLogInteraction
methods.description: A function for logging user interactions such as bar clicks and legend clicks for auditing purposes.
